---
title: "HangmanneR"
---

HangmanneR is hangman played with CRAN package names. You guess one letter at a
time against a package sampled from a snapshot of CRAN metadata that ships with
the package, 19,838 of them.

There is a hosted copy at
<https://matiasandina-hangmanner.share.connect.posit.cloud/>, running on Posit
Connect Cloud. You can also run it locally.

## Install

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("matiasandina/HangmanneR")
```

## Run

```r
library(HangmanneR)
run_app()
```

`run_app()` hands `...` to `shiny::shinyApp()`, so the usual options still work:

```r
run_app(options = list(port = 1234))
```

## Playing

Type a letter and the guess registers on its own, or click Guess Letter. Digits
and the dot count as guesses too, because package names use them. Six wrong
guesses end the round, and the hearts under the controls are what is left.

Difficulty filters the pool by the length of the package name: Easy is 2 to 7
characters, Normal is 8 to 15, Hard is 16 and up. The Posit checkbox keeps only
packages with Posit Software, PBC in the author field. Changing either setting
deals a new package.

Hint shows the package description with the name blanked out. The description
comes up on its own when the round ends, next to a link to the package on CRAN.

## The data

The CSV holds the package name, the author field and the description for each
package. It comes from [TidyTuesday 2023 week
38](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday), which in turn derives from
the [CRAN Collaboration Graph](https://github.com/schochastics/CRAN_collaboration).
It is a snapshot, so packages published since then will not show up.
